_readme: Walk list and shared text. Colour code in any text: [[r:...]] = RED, best guess not yet confirmed by the owner; [[c:...]] = CYAN, new idea or new puzzle suggested by Claude; plain text = confirmed. Stops appear in the order listed in 'stops'. 'route' lists all 20 planned stops (only some have content files yet). Map positions are x,y on map/warmington-map.svg (viewBox 215 470 490 430).
title: The Missing Message
subtitle: Warmington Medium Walk
welcome_text: [[r:A sealed order has gone missing from the estate. You are a servant of the estate, and the housekeeper needs it found before the evening collection. Walk the village, follow the clues, and work out who took it, why, and where it is hidden.]]
start_text: [[r:Start at the Red Lion pub, on the Peterborough Road at Eaglethorpe. There is a car park. You do not need to buy anything.]]
map_note: [[r:Today's village layout, drawn in an old style. The modern streets and buildings are not shown as if they stood in the 1600s.]]
